data.title: War Robot Spotlight: Artemis
data.content:
As a Wild Ten Pilot, it’s good to get to grips with your partner in battle—the War Robot. With several War Robots to choose from, each with its own unique attributes, picking the best ally for each fight is crucial.

Engineered for precision and sustained pressure, Artemis utilizes its Hunter’s Mark to expose enemy positions and shatter their defenses, turning every successful takedown into a vital recovery surge for the entire squad.

Starting May 19, Artemis will be available through Daily Deals and direct offers.

Combat Analysis

  • War Robot Model: Artemis
  • Class: Tactician
  • Dominion: Mayflower

Artemis is a nimble backline predator, perfect for Pilots who prefer to dictate the flow of battle while staying out of the crossfire. Though light on armor, its exceptional mobility and light hardpoints with long range weaponry allow it to punish enemies from the safety of the rear.

While Artemis lacks the raw durability for frontline brawling, it excels at dismantling high-value targets using Hunter’s Mark. By exposing enemies and weakening their plating, it ensures the vanguard stays healthy; every mark-assisted takedown repairs the armor of nearby allies, turning Artemis into a crucial lifeline for the team's heaviest hitters.

Consider using it with new Velites. These light plasma cannons optimized for long-range engagements up to 700m

Stats shown are for max level, factory build. Stats are subject to change pending future balancing updates.
